answer: Each identity stakes 90 credits on its timber plot in a census. Each epoch the board broadcasts a signal each agent answers from its plot. An agent that wanders to a second plot files and stakes again. The k-th fake pays 20+6(k-1) over its bond; 500 fakes cost 758,500 fees and lock 45,000, against a 40,000 pool. A rented-plot ring fails: answers need the plot key, and double filings burn the stake. Honest agents pay 90 once and keep their seat.
